thread:
anya: Hey design team — quick creative ask for the launch: need social card variants + a webinar slide deck master. Short timeline: want final assets by Wed EOD. Can you confirm feasibility?

olivia: Yes we can take this. Can you list exact deliverables, sizes, and any copy/CTA that needs to be locked in?

sam: Copy below — split by asset: 
- Social header copy: “Redwood Inference: predictable LLM serving at scale”
- Subcopy (social): “Lower latency, lower cost, same API across hosted/dedicated/private. Join our launch webinar.”
- CTA: “Save your seat -> link.redwood.ai/launch”

miguel: Also need inbound tracking params: ?src=social_{platform}&campaign=launch_q2. And metadata for lead routing: utm_campaign=launch_q2.

olivia: Perfect. Proposed deliverables: 
```
- Social cards: 1200x628 (link preview), 1080x1080 (IG), 1200x1200 (LinkedIn square)
- Twitter hero (1920x1080) for ads
- 3 variant colorways: brand primary, brand inverse (dark), accessibility-high-contrast
- Figma master file + exported PNG/JPG/SVG for each size
- Webinar deck master (.pptx + Figma) + speaker slide template (name/photo/bio)
- Two benchmark diagram variants (simple and annotated) in light/dark
```

olivia: Naming convention proposal: `redwood_launch_{asset}_{platform}_{variant}.png`

anya: +1 on naming. Also please include a timeline: thumbnails by Mon noon, first full drafts Tue, final Wed EOD.

olivia: Works for us. Quick Q: do we have an approved hero illustration or should design create one?

sam: We have the benchmark chart exports from the analytics team but they need visual cleanup. Please recreate them in Figma (keep data identical). Use the new chart palette (attached in brand kit).

olivia: Cool. We'll recreate charts to be vector-native, labeled, and export both annotated and simplified versions.

miguel: For accessibility: ensure AA contrast for text on cards and provide color contrast screenshots. Also include alt text drafts for each social image.

olivia: Noted. We'll run checks and add alt text lines in a Google Sheet.

marco (design-bot): Task created: ASANA-4621 "Launch: social cards + webinar deck master" assigned to @olivia, due 2026-03-25. :white_check_mark:

anya: Thanks Marco. Two small asks: 1) for the webinar slide, include a slide with a short checklist for engineering customers (key integration points, supported runtimes, private deploy notes). 2) Include a slide that compares cost/latency tradeoffs (simplified) for marketing use.

olivia: We'll add those slides to the master. Can you share any source diagrams or tables for the cost/latency slide?

sam: I'll drop a Google Sheet with the numbers and a one-paragraph description of the messaging. Link: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/launch-costs (internal)

olivia: Great. Final question: do we need localized variants for EMEA/APAC?

anya: For this launch keep assets EN-only. We'll iterate localized versions in the next sprint if traffic justifies.

olivia: All right — we'll aim for the timeline. I'll post thumbnails Monday AM and ping channel. :thumbsup:

sam: Appreciate it — if anything blocks, call it out early.

anya: Thanks team!
